purpose: Coordinate safe and timely resolution of blocked customer orders
triggers: order-blocked event mapped to a known order
scheduled review of an open exception
retry request referencing a failed attempt
requiredInputs: current inventory, capacity, credit, and payment observations
expectedOutcomes: order released through an authorized resolution
complete proposal delivered to the required approver
safe stop when authority or context cannot be established
escalationConditions: authority limit exceeded or grant expired
confidenceBoundaries: exception class not in the declared classification set
proposed value within 10 percent of a limit
